usedFor: Minelead finds email addresses and company contacts, and “Add Leads” and “Verify Email” keep a lead list clean.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Add Leads” in Minelead
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message becomes a lead in Minelead, so the sender is not lost in a chat.

watchOut: Any email you send to a lead still waits in Needs you for your approval.
